GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
URBAN SERVICES (WORKS) DEPARTMENT
Dated: 11-07-2023
Circular Memo No.USD01-WRKS0/9/2023
Sub: Urban Services - Works - Monsoon 2023 Emergency works Powers of the
Commissioner - Instructions - Reg.
Ref:
G.O.Ms.No.14, Urban Services (Works) Department, Dt. 18-03-2021.
***
1. In view of the heavy rainfall forecast during the monsoon season, Urban Local Bodies are
required to take up emergency works such as restoration of drains and culverts without 
delay.
2. In order to avoid delays, it is clarified that the Commissioner, Urban Services, may accord
administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.50 crore per work.
3. Such sanctions shall be reported to the Government every month.
B. RAJASEKHAR
SECRETARY TO GOVERNMENT
To
The Commissioner, Urban Services, A.P.
Copy to:
All Superintending Engineers (through Commissioner).
//FORWARDED :: BY ORDER//
